headline: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 reaches 18.63% matched code with 69 more function matches
summary: Deadlocked gained matches in multiplayer-menu and shared-level code, plus its core, networking and game code (#181, #182). The project's progress report puts NTSC-U v1.00 at 18.63% matched code by size, up from 18.54%, with 9,476 of 18,172 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: #181 ports 48 NTSC-U level functions from already-matched twins, covering the multiplayer menu and shared code. The pull request says all 48 also match on PAL.
#182 adds 21 NTSC-U matches: one core function, nine networking functions, two game functions and nine overlay functions.
PAL work remains proposed: #183 offers 31 overlay-function matches, while #184 adds an audit of relocation targets for PAL-native C. Neither had merged by day's end.
